lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The Core Record opens — bright, incomplete. Gaps remain where memories were never found.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: You bought her time. Not forgiveness.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Without the full record I still see a lattice risk — not a people I can trust. I am holding the drones. That is caution, not belief.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Earth will send another fleet. When they ask why the drones stood down, I will have no answer that saves you.

lines.speaker: GAIA
lines.text: Then we will still be here when they arrive. Incomplete — but awake.

lines.speaker: KAELA
lines.text: Next time, we bring him the rest of the truth.

panels.then: title card THE CORE HOLDS over the upper sky
